name: יַחְצְאֵל
summary: A son of Naphtali who went down to Egypt with Jacob (Gen 46:24), head of the clan of the Jahzeelites (הַיַּחְצְאֵלִי, Num 26:48); spelled יַחֲצִיאֵל in 1Ch 7:13. The name reads as the imperfect of חָצָה with אֵל, “God divides” or “God apportions”, as יֶחֱצוּ in Exo 21:35 and Psa 55:24; scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “The sons of Naphtali: יַחְצְאֵל and Guni and Jezer and Shillem.”
The imperfect יֶחֱצוּן “they shall divide”, the verb form in the name.
Dividing the spoil into shares: the sense “apportion”.

note: Takes h.ex.af (the name, 3 tokens), h.ex.ag (the gentilic Jahzeelite, Num 26:48) and j.bh.ac (a zero-token cross-reference). TIPNR records one person, Jahzeel@Gen.46.24, with all three forms. The meaning is a reading of the form (imperfect + אֵל); no verse gives it.
